fraction_basis: Normalized over the modeled crystalline phases; amorphous or unidentified content is not quantified.

measurement_model.point_weights: Poisson approximation, sigma=sqrt(observed counts), because pointwise uncertainties were not supplied

phases.cell_and_atomic_model: Fixed to the audited reference model because the phase is too weak for reliable structural refinement.
phases.name: bixbyite manganese(III) oxide (tentative minor phase)

uncertainty_note: Reported fraction esds are GSAS-II covariance estimates under the adopted model. The 0.431 wt% Mn2O3 result is near the practical detection/model-discrimination limit and is more uncertain systematically than its covariance esd; Ia-3, Pbca and I213 Mn2O3 models were not decisively distinguishable.
